Boston (49-24) arrives in the Queen City currently holding the No. 2 seed in the East and looking to extend their two-game winning streak. However, the Celtics are navigating a "trap game" scenario, with four-fifths of their starting lineup—including Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown—listed as questionable ahead of a pivotal back-to-back. Meanwhile, the Hornets (39-35) are fighting to maintain their top-eight standing and prove their mid-season turnaround was no fluke. Catch every second of this broadcast live on Fubo. This matchup is a battle of contrasting trajectories. The Celtics boast the league's most efficient net rating and are led by the scoring brilliance of Jaylen Brown, who is averaging a career-best 28.6 points per game. Charlotte, however, has become one of the NBA's most dangerous home teams since January. Behind the breakout stardom of Brandon Miller and the elite floor generalship of LaMelo Ball, the Hornets have transformed from a lottery team into a legitimate postseason threat. For Charlotte to secure the upset, they must capitalize on a potentially shorthanded Boston roster. You can witness this Eastern Conference clash streaming live on Fubo. Boston's depth will be the central theme tonight. If Tatum and Brown are limited, the scoring load will shift to Payton Pritchard, who is coming off a massive 36-point performance earlier this week. For the Hornets, the focus remains on interior dominance; Moussa Diabaté has been a revelation on the glass, providing the second-chance opportunities Charlotte needs to fuel their transition attack. Despite the gap in the standings, the Hornets are slight favorites at home given Boston’s lengthy injury report.
